title: spawn a new agent to build a feature to: change Bench tab text top right to a wrench icon on far right of top left pane…
summary: I gave the change to a new agent, FEN6. It will replace the "Bench" text tab in the top right with a wrench icon on the far right of the top left panel, and Bench will open the same way it does now. I'll post here when it reports back.
